text:
Priya S: Quick check 1 0 I'm wrapping up a PR to tighten the Greeter quickstart onboarding (auth + first deploy). PR #4123. Need someone to sanity-check the snippets and Windows guidance.
Alex P: I can take this. Will spin up the sample and run through the steps.
Priya S: thanks. Main problems I flagged: env var names are inconsistent across files (API_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY), snippets assume bash-only, and the docker example omits a PORT override so it fails on default 3000 if you override.
Dan M: paste the .env snippet so I can run the linter on fixtures.
Priya S: current .env in repo: ```
# .env
API_KEY=REDACTED
PORT=3000
```
Alex P: lints fine but reproducibility is off. README instructs `export API_KEY=... && npm run start` which isn't friendly to PowerShell/Windows devs. Also we should recommend a single canonical var REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Marie L: agree on canonical name. Also suggest adding a one-liner for PowerShell: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "<key>"; npm run start` and a short note pointing folks to use a .env loader like dotenv or cross-env for scripts.
Priya S: good. For Docker compose, we should show how to set env in compose and map ports. Current example: ```yaml
services:
  greeter:
    image: greeter:latest
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
```
Alex P: change to `- "${GREETER_PORT:-3000}:3000"` and show `GREETER_PORT` in .env. That makes local overrides easier.
Dan M: while testing, I noticed deploy section references the older CLI command `redwood serve`. Newer SDK docs use `redwood start`. We should update the command and include a note about migrating CLI v2->v3 behavior.
docs-bot: PR #4123 updated by priya 1 labels: docs, quickstart, auth
Priya S: plan: Alex adds cross-platform snippets + dotenv note; Dan updates deploy cmd and adds migration footnote; I'll normalize env names to REDWOOD_API_KEY and adjust docker-compose port example. Marie can you do a copyedit after changes? Target: Merge by EOD tomorrow.
Marie L: yep, will do a language pass once the PR is updated. :mag: 
deploy-bot: smoke tests queued for branch priya/greeter-onboard-fix 1 status: queued
Alex P: pushing a small commit with PowerShell + bash examples and the dotenv callout. Also updated README to prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Priya S: awesome, once tests pass I'll rebase and request reviews. Thanks all :heart:
